title: tecoma radicans var. thunbergii
intro: Tecoma radicans var. thunbergii, commonly known as the "Yellow Trumpet Vine", is a flowering plant species native to the southeastern United States and parts of Asia. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Tecoma radicans var. thunbergii are attributed to its ability to modulate immune function, reduce inflammation, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
